# Tableclock

> Tableclock times turns for two to eight board-game players sharing one device.

Try the isolated four-player sample at https://tableclock.sociobot.in/demo. It works offline after the first visit. Player names stay in the browser.

## Pages

- [Tableclock](https://tableclock.sociobot.in/): Set up and run a clock.
- [Demo](https://tableclock.sociobot.in/demo): Try an isolated running sample.
- [Privacy](https://tableclock.sociobot.in/privacy/): Local storage and privacy details.
- [Terms](https://tableclock.sociobot.in/terms/): Terms and timing limitations.
